sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Get full cycle data for all 5 positions
# First, get blue strip pixel counts for reference
seg = current_frame.segmentation
blue_pixels = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B':
        b = node['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if 40 <= min_row <= 45:
            blue_pixels.append({'col': min_col, 'pixels': node['pixels'], 'hash': node['hash'][:8]})
blue_pixels.sort(key=lambda x: x['col'])
print(f"Blue strip: {[(bp['col'], bp['pixels'], bp['hash']) for bp in blue_pixels]}")

# Get top grid pink-bg and blue-bg symbol pixel counts
pink_bg = {}
blue_bg = {}
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B':
        b = node['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if min_row < 30:
            # Determine if this symbol is on pink or blue bg by checking surrounding
            # Check the cell above the symbol
            above_row = min_row - 1
            for bnode in seg['nodes']:
                if bnode['color'] == 'P':
                    bb = bnode['boundary']
                    bb_rows = [p[0] for p in bb]
                    bb_cols = [p[1] for p in bb]
                    if min(bb_rows) <= above_row <= max(bb_rows) and min(bb_cols) <= min_col <= max(bb_cols):
                        pink_bg[node['hash'][:8]] = node['pixels']
                        break
            for bnode in seg['nodes']:
                if bnode['color'] == 'S':
                    bb = bnode['boundary']
                    bb_rows = [p[0] for p in bb]
                    bb_cols = [p[1] for p in bb]
                    if min(bb_rows) <= above_row <= max(bb_rows) and min(bb_cols) <= min_col <= max(bb_cols):
                        blue_bg[node['hash'][:8]] = node['pixels']
                        break

print(f"Pink-bg top symbols: {pink_bg}")
print(f"Blue-bg top symbols: {blue_bg}")

# Now get cycle data for all 5 positions
# Position columns: ~15, ~22, ~29, ~36, ~43
pos_cols = [(14, 18), (21, 25), (28, 32), (35, 39), (42, 46)]
all_cycles = {}

for pos_idx, (cmin, cmax) in enumerate(pos_cols):
    if pos_idx > 0:
        action(['RIGHT'])
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    # Get current symbol
    start_sym = None
    for node in seg['nodes']:
        if node['color'] == 'B':
            b = node['boundary']
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if 50 <= min_row <= 55 and cmin <= min_col <= cmax:
                start_sym = {'hash': node['hash'][:8], 'pixels': node['pixels']}
                break
    
    if start_sym is None:
        print(f"Pos {pos_idx}: could not find symbol")
        continue
    
    cycle = [start_sym]
    start_hash = start_sym['hash']
    
    for i in range(10):
        action(['UP'])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        for node in seg['nodes']:
            if node['color'] == 'B':
                b = node['boundary']
                min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
                min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
                if 50 <= min_row <= 55 and cmin <= min_col <= cmax:
                    sym = {'hash': node['hash'][:8], 'pixels': node['pixels']}
                    cycle.append(sym)
                    if sym['hash'] == start_hash and len(cycle) > 1:
                        cycle = cycle[:-1]
                    break
    
    all_cycles[pos_idx] = cycle
    pixels = [s['pixels'] for s in cycle]
    hashes = [s['hash'] for s in cycle]
    print(f"Pos {pos_idx}: pixels={pixels}, hashes={hashes}")

# Check: which pink-bg and blue-bg hashes are reachable at each position?
print(f"\nReachability analysis:")
for pos_idx, cycle in all_cycles.items():
    cycle_hashes = set(s['hash'] for s in cycle)
    pink_reachable = [h for h in pink_bg if h in cycle_hashes]
    blue_reachable = [h for h in blue_bg if h in cycle_hashes]
    print(f"Pos {pos_idx}: pink-bg reachable={pink_reachable}, blue-bg reachable={blue_reachable}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
